brief: A caddy for next to my kitchen sink: a dispenser that pours out bleach for wiping the counters, plus two bins for sponges.

requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full, lockJoints + capOpenFaces, check_build ok meshClash clear
requirements.requirement: Caddy for next to kitchen sink (small clustered holder)

requirements.evidence: No dispenser/pour/tap/valve/bottle part in catalog; only hex-port-barb (hose spigot) exists, which is not a controlled pour dispenser and I removed it rather than misrepresent it. Cell 0,0,0 left open. Configurator checks fit only and knows nothing about materials, bleach/chemical resistance or food safety, so bleach suitability can never be met.
requirements.requirement: Dispenser that pours out bleach for wiping counters

requirements.evidence: bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain — two full-depth drained bins for wet sponges

finish.summary: Built 3-cell caddy with two drained sponge bins; no bleach-pouring dispenser exists in the parts catalog and printed-part bleach safety cannot be verified, so that requirement is unmet. Empty centre cell left to hold the user's own bleach bottle.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.
